label.en: Education operating fund (1 year of activities)

notes.id: Fullday: dana pengembangan dan infaq amal jariyah ditentukan saat wawancara sesuai kemampuan. SPP kelas reguler Rp450.000, kelas peminatan (IT, bilingual, KKO, riset, tahfidz) Rp600.000. Boarding: total masuk Rp18.650.000 (putra) / Rp18.900.000 (putri), termasuk infaq min. Rp4.000.000 dan dana pengembangan min. Rp5.000.000; biaya bulanan Rp1.650.000–Rp1.800.000 (makan, asrama, kegiatan asrama, SPP). Halaman berjudul 2027/2028 tetapi teksnya juga menyebut 2025/2026; jadwal gelombang menunjukkan penerimaan 2027/2028.
notes.en: Day school: development fund and infaq are set at the interview according to ability. Tuition: regular class Rp450,000, specialist classes (IT, bilingual, sports, research, tahfidz) Rp600,000. Boarding: total on entry Rp18,650,000 (boys) / Rp18,900,000 (girls), including infaq of at least Rp4,000,000 and development fund of at least Rp5,000,000; monthly Rp1,650,000–Rp1,800,000 (meals, boarding, boarding activities, tuition). The page is titled 2027/2028 but its text also mentions 2025/2026; the wave dates point to the 2027/2028 intake.
